title: Harmony’s Form 20-F filing
summary: The post Harmony’s Form 20-F filing appeared first on Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited .
body_markdown:
**Johannesburg, Friday, 30 October 2026.** Further to the announcement made on 23 October 2026, Harmony wishes to advise shareholders that it filed its annual report on a Form 20-F for the year ended 30 June 2026 with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on Friday, 30 October 2026.


The document is available on the Company’s website at[https://www.harmony.co.za/investors/annual-reports/2026/](https://www.harmony.co.za/investors/annual-reports/2026/) and[https://www.har.co.za/26/](https://www.har.co.za/26/) and the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](http://www.sec.gov/) .
